llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: (1) it uses the name and address of a real, unrelated fisheries company (有限会社寺本水産) while offering a wide range of heavily discounted, unrelated products (electronics, clothes, toys); (2) the contact email uses a suspicious .live domain, not a proper corporate email; (3) generic privacy and business descriptions, frequent tactics in scams; (4) product categories and discounts are inconsistent with the type of business the real company operates. This matches several scam warning signs, especially impersonation of a legitimate company and offering goods they do not sell.
